cardManager.Name: Card Manager
cardManager.Label: Manage Cards
cardManager.Hint: Create, edit, import and export the cards of the Critical Hit and Critical Fumble decks.

enableHitDeck.Name: Enable Critical Hit Deck
enableHitDeck.Hint: Offer a Critical Hit card when an attack meets the trigger conditions below.

enableFumbleDeck.Name: Enable Critical Fumble Deck
enableFumbleDeck.Hint: Offer a Critical Fumble card when an attack meets the trigger conditions below.

triggerAttacks.Name: Trigger on Attack Rolls
triggerAttacks.Hint: Strikes and spell attack rolls can trigger a deck.

triggerSaves.Name: Trigger on Saving Throws
triggerSaves.Hint: Saving throws can trigger a deck. Only general cards are drawn for them.

triggerSkills.Name: Trigger on Skill Checks
triggerSkills.Hint: Skill and Perception checks can trigger a deck. Only general cards are drawn for them.

triggerAllRolls.Name: Trigger on Every Roll
triggerAllRolls.Hint: Every roll containing a d20 can trigger a deck (initiative, flat checks, plain /roll 1d20, …), regardless of the three settings above. Rolls without a PF2e degree of success can only trigger via natural values.

triggerMode.Name: Trigger Mode
triggerMode.Hint: Decides when a deck is triggered by an attack roll.
triggerMode.degree: Degree of success (critical success / critical failure)
triggerMode.either: Natural value OR critical degree of success
triggerMode.both: Natural value AND critical degree of success

hitNaturals.Name: Critical Hit: Natural Values
hitNaturals.Hint: Natural d20 results that trigger the Critical Hit Deck. Comma-separated, ranges allowed, e.g. "20" or "18-20".

fumbleNaturals.Name: Critical Fumble: Natural Values
fumbleNaturals.Hint: Natural d20 results that trigger the Critical Fumble Deck. Comma-separated, ranges allowed, e.g. "1" or "1, 2".

triggerActors.Name: Trigger For
triggerActors.Hint: Whose attack rolls can trigger a deck.

gmPrompt.Name: When Triggered
gmPrompt.Hint: What happens when an attack triggers a deck.
gmPrompt.ask: Ask the GM in a private chat message
gmPrompt.auto: Draw immediately and show the card to the GM

playerDraw.Name: Players Draw Themselves
playerDraw.Hint: Instead of the GM drawing in private, three face-down cards are dealt in front of everyone and the rolling player picks one. The GM still decides whether a draw happens at all (see "When Triggered") and can, after the reveal, accept the card, let the player choose another or deal three new cards.

useDamageTypes.Name: Differentiate Damage Types
useDamageTypes.Hint: If enabled, specific cards can be bound to a damage type (bludgeoning, slashing, …) and are only drawn for attacks dealing that type. If disabled, all damage types are treated as one and the damage type of a card is ignored.

deckBehavior.Name: Deck Behavior
deckBehavior.Hint: Whether revealed cards go back into the deck or stay on a discard pile until the deck runs out.
deckBehavior.replace: Shuffle back – every draw uses the full deck
deckBehavior.discard: Discard revealed cards until the deck is empty

revealPopup.Name: Reveal Popup
revealPopup.Hint: Show revealed cards as an animated popup to all players (in addition to the chat message).

animations.Name: Card Animations
animations.Hint: Play the draw and flip animations on this client.

State.playerDrawing: The player is drawing a card…

Draw.Empty: There are no cards in this deck for this attack type. Add some in the Card Manager.
Draw.Cycled: You have seen every card of this pool – starting over.

Manager.Title: Critical Deck Card Manager
Manager.Hint: General cards can be drawn for any roll. Specific cards are only drawn for attacks of their attack type – and, if damage types are enabled in the module settings, of their damage type. "Any" leaves that criterion open. Saving throws, skill checks and other rolls only draw general cards. Changes are stored when you click Save.
Manager.TestDrawHint: Opens the draw window with the saved cards of this deck.
Manager.EffectPlaceholder: Effect text, e.g. "You trip over a rock and fall prone."
Manager.Reshuffled: All discard piles have been shuffled back into their decks.
Manager.ImportInvalid: The file does not contain a valid card list.
Manager.ImportQuestion: The file contains {count} card(s). Add them to the existing cards or replace all existing cards?
Manager.Imported: {count} card(s) imported. Click Save to keep them.
Manager.AttackTypeHint: Attack type this card is drawn for
Manager.DamageTypeHint: Damage type this card is drawn for

Warn.GMOnly: Only a GM can draw critical cards.
Warn.NotPF2e: Havoc Critical Decks is built for the Pathfinder 2e system. Automatic triggers will not work in this system.

Manual.Title: Draw a Critical Card
Manual.Hint: Draw a card without a roll. The draw works like a triggered one, so you can still decline the card afterwards.

PlayerDraw.Title: {actor} draws from the {deck}!
PlayerDraw.RevealedGM: Accept the card, let them choose another one, or deal new cards.
